briefings.text:
Good morning. It is 7 °C and overcast, with rain expected after 15:00 — take a jacket.

You have two events today: a dentist appointment at 10:30 and the plumber at 14:00 (the garage door is still open from last night, by the way).

The guest room heater has been on for 36 hours; shall I turn it off?

Good morning. Clear skies today, high of 14 °C.

Nothing on the calendar. Trash goes out tonight — it is Tuesday.
Good evening. Everyone is home. Doors are locked, the garage is closed, and the upstairs thermostat is set to 19 °C for the night.
